# graylog_pipeline_connection (Resource)

Connects one or more processing pipelines to a stream. Each stream can have multiple pipelines connected to it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graylog_pipeline_connection" "example" {
  stream_id    = graylog_stream.application_logs.id
  pipeline_ids = [graylog_pipeline.example.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pipeline_ids` (Set of String) Set of pipeline IDs to connect to the stream.
- `stream_id` (String) The stream ID to connect pipelines to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The connection ID (same as stream_id).
